Structural repair survives attack; precise September breakout and original DeFi leadership success remain unestablished. Directional consistency is not demonstrated economic usefulness. VERIFIED below means reproducible arithmetic or field comparisons within the supplied packet, not external authentication or canonical truth.

FROZEN CRITERIA AUDIT
The original strengthening criteria were BTC and ETH bottom-zone hold/reclaim; ETH/BTC higher lows, holding above 0.0265 and later testing 0.030; BTC.D ceasing acceleration; breadth surviving rallies; DeFi/Aave leadership surviving 12+ days and broadening across names; and stabilized/positive ETF 7-day flow with spot quality. The supplied evidence supports limited bottom-zone recovery and the September numerical ratio components. Breadth improved temporarily. BTC.D, ETF/spot quality and original sector survival remain UNKNOWN.

The original adverse criteria were persistent BTC closes below approximately USD 59,400; ETH zone loss without absorption; ETH/BTC below June lows; BTC.D reclaim/acceleration alongside weaker alts; DeFi leadership dying within 5–12 days; September ending without durable breakout; breakout failing weekly confirmation; and Type-2/Type-3 fake rotation. Missing observations do not establish that these failures occurred—or that they were absent. The August 1 pre-window checkpoint is not independently reproduced.

TIMING VERDICT
Withhold a strict September HIT. The September ratio repair is real within the supplied fields, but the chart-defined event and survival requirement cannot be reproduced. Conversely, do not declare a strict market-event FAIL merely because its confirmation record is missing. If complete original-trigger evidence demonstrated no durable breakout by September 30, that timing claim would fail even though numerical repair succeeded. Thus the memo's PARTIAL label is acceptable only as a description of mixed components, not as earned partial timing credit.

The W36 open on August 31 was already 0.03111: presence above 0.030 in September does not establish a first breakout occurring in September. W39's approximately 2.33% ratio decline is admissible adverse evidence. The W40 full-week close of 0.03152 includes October 1–4 and is excluded from the September score. Its September 30–October 1 aggregate block cannot isolate September 30. W41 narrative is post-window context only.

LEADERSHIP VERDICT
The original test cannot be scored. It requires Aave outperformance against BTC and ETH, at least three prospectively identified DeFi names, broader ROC improvement, survival through BTC chop/pullback, non-deteriorating ETH/BTC and breadth, improved stablecoin deployment, and non-aggressive BTC.D reclaim. The supplied later author scores establish none of that original sequence or first-leader ranking. Missing evidence is not equivalent to leadership failure.

DIVERGENCE, COST AND INCREMENTAL VALUE
One material classification divergence is demonstrable: a 0.030-only substitute would produce a September numerical HIT, whereas the frozen source-specific test yields an unresolved strict event. A second proposed substitution—later DeFi scores for July survival—would turn an unresolved original outcome into unsupported success. These are scoring divergences, not observed policy decisions.

False-positive learning: repair or short-lookback breadth can be mislabeled as confirmed timing, broad rotation or sector leadership. False-negative learning: rejecting the whole package would erase supported ratio repair and provisional bottom recovery. The observed +4.09% W36-to-W38 ratio move and subsequent approximately −2.33% W39 move illustrate endpoint sensitivity; neither is a monetary false-negative or false-positive cost. Monetary costs, error rates, decision-value divergence and incremental predictive value versus simpler contemporaneous evidence are UNKNOWN. No policy replay or portfolio counterfactual is justified.

GOALPOST AND KNOWLEDGE-TIME INTEGRITY
Issues #98–#100 are admissible as timestamped source-state and separate revision context, not rescue evidence. Issue #99 changed the BTC sequence order; Issue #100 reduced its September–October BTC range from USD 94,000–98,000 to USD 84,000–88,000. That is a USD 10,000 reduction at each endpoint, but it concerns later issues and cannot be charged to or credited against TD-97 as though it were TD-97's original numerical forecast. DeFi reruns occur after July 13. Revision-related adverse moves, confirmation delays and economic costs cannot be reconstructed here.

REUSABLE LEARNING AND ANALYTICAL CLOSEOUT
Retain the evidenced distinction between bottom-zone survival and pattern proof, numerical repair and chart-trigger confirmation, temporary breadth and durable transmission, and source-sector scores and independent leadership outcomes. The packet supports those distinctions, not a verified predictive edge. Matured portions receive the dispositions above without a permanent rescue window; immature horizons remain unscored and cannot repair matured claims. This completes only the read-only analytical assessment. No ledger closure, release, repository modification, canonical promotion or other framework state change has been performed.
